text:
ana: Heads up — base-image rebase in the 02:00 UTC window triggered audit-shipper 403s and a growing backlog.

ben: saw alert. queue spiked to ~8k. Any keystore changes this window?

chie: yes, pushed keystore policy v2 that tightened list/get on public keys and rotated a signing subkey at 01:52.

ana: logs: ```
[02:05] audit-shipper ERROR err="403 PermissionDenied" target=/keystore/v1/publickeys queue=8200
[02:06] audit-shipper WARN retrying
```

ben: that indicates audit-shipper lost read access to public keys. It runs as svc:auditor/shipper@prod. Did the policy remove its get permission?

chie: looks like the new role only grants verify:signer/* and omitted keystore.get-public for the auditing principal. my bad.

sec-bot: Automatic mitigation suggestion: create short-lived keystore:get-public binding for the shipper.

ana: please apply a TTL exception so the backlog drains, and pause rebuilds until we confirm.

chie: applied `keystore.get-public -> svc:auditor/shipper@prod (ttl=15m)`. sec-bot recorded change id pc-9001.

ben: thanks. backlog started draining immediately. build-bot paused rebuilds.

ana: follow-ups:
- chie: PR a least-privilege role that includes keystore:get-public for audit-shipper (terraform + policy).
- ben: update deploy checklist: do key rotations separate from RBAC tightens and run a post-rotate keystore smoke test.
- ops: add auto-pause rule in rebuild runbook when audit queue > 5k.

chie: will post terraform snippet to eng-security for review.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-1802 assigned to chie/ben.

ana: closing once PR merges and runbook updated.
